target_semantics: Each family used SDK max_games=10 at concurrency 1. Games ending on the opponent move did not advance the SDK counter, so realized family denominators were larger.

exact_configuration_and_role_matches_to_.warning: Only three exact matched cells; matchmaking was not randomized.

bargaining.activation_result: DiscountLatch accepted a repeated 20% nominal offer at round 4 for a discounted 17.15% pot payoff. Granola replay would reject, but its counterfactual terminal payoff is unobserved.

challenger_cell.warning: Buckwheat's counter was accepted; acceptance of Granola's more favorable counter is an unobserved counterfactual.

buyer.largest_loss_diagnosis: Binary seller sent yes in all 20 rounds. Buckwheat bought the first 9, observed 1 high and 8 lows, then stopped. Public-prior purchase EV was strictly positive; Granola replay makes the same decisions.

classification.revealed_template_evidence: All five purchased below-usual-quality messages were low quality. Correct negative classification would have avoided five 1,000,000 losses in that trace; the 14 ordinary-unit qualities remained censored because Buckwheat passed.

same_observation_replay.warning: Replay divergence is not a counterfactual-payoff estimate because opponents could respond differently.

conclusion.bargaining: Retain as a promising challenger, but one activation is insufficient for promotion to Granola.
conclusion.negotiation: The narrow challenger cell succeeded, but the lower rating and single activation do not establish superiority.
conclusion.persuasion: Exact-indifference downside gate passed, but the preregistered 95% text-coverage gate failed. Five below-usual-quality messages were all revealed lows, providing direct evidence for a narrow negative-template fix. Do not promote this module without freezing that revision and running another cohort.
conclusion.overall: Buckwheat is operationally valid and competitive, but the cohort does not support replacing Granola wholesale.
